record.official_identifier: Assembly Bill 406 (83rd Session, 2025); Statutes of Nevada 2025, Chapter 283
record.notes: Approved by the Governor on 5 June 2025 and filed as Chapter 283 on 6 June 2025; effective 1 July 2025. It passed the Assembly 42-0 on 22 April 2025 and, as amended, the Senate 20-1 on 21 May 2025, and the Assembly concurred in Senate Amendment No. 664 on 29 May 2025. Primary sponsors: Assemblymembers Jovan Jackson and Hanadi Nadeem. The law amends NRS chapters 391, 433 and 629. A licensed provider who breaches the AI rules commits unprofessional conduct and is subject to discipline by the provider's licensing board. One of the first state laws, with Illinois HB 1806, to bar AI from delivering therapy.

verification.note: CAUTION: no official source was stored. The FastDemocracy bill-tracker page, which cites the Nevada Legislature's NELIS bill page as its source, gives the legislative history: introduction on 11 March 2025, floor votes, Senate Amendment No. 664, approval by the Governor on 5 June 2025 and Chapter 283 on 6 June 2025. The NASW Nevada page quotes the enacted provisions (sections 2, 7 and 8), including the USD 15,000 civil penalty. Not in the stored files: the effective date of 1 July 2025 (from a Wilson Sonsini client alert seen in a search excerpt in October 2026), the Governor's name and the NRS chapters amended (from the October 2026 research). The NELIS page and the enrolled bill PDF returned HTTP 403 in October 2026.
